answer: Suppose a farm wants a hundred names by morning. Designated storage facility manager registration with storage managers verification says no: a registration managers keep after unit audits stands in the way, and the whisper of each fake is a separate errand in the physical world. Growth punishes the attacker here, not the network: the gale rises with each new clone while the payout per clone never moves, so the farm bankrupts itself first. The jetty is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
